summary: Selected AD-1 as the first local-chat direction. Design basis: AD-1 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, Decisions / Local chat interface; browser observations are planned and not yet run.

criteria.text: Apply AD-1 from docs/shiploop/spec.md, section Visual defaults. Render at mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x1000 in light and dark themes using #f5f2eb, #ffffff, #4f66bf and 72rem. The browser command is planned, not run.
